items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And so we got a chance to see a lot of the popular comedians, vocalists, dancers -- tap dancers -- Bill Robinson. Well, we saw everybody.

ctx.x: Swinging The Dream. And, of course, it starts out with Bill Robinson and Shirley Temple, and a lot of other things that happened.
So, I think we came to the conclusion that the writer wrapping up the decade, and this was 1939, so he put everything in one... But there was no mention of anything from Swinging The Dream.
